message: OPERATOR DIRECTIVE: Own and maintain an explicit, durable, dependency-ordered EXECUTION PLAN to achieve the current goal: complete the SQLite-backed Work orchestration/self-hosting migration safely, through reviewed implementation, integration, merged .NET11 Release/restore/recovery readiness gates, and explicit operator-authorized cutover (do not perform cutover without GO). Define milestones, critical path, exact prerequisites/GO-HOLD conditions, independently parallelizable bounded tasks, worker assignments/leases, reviews/integration gates, and actionable next dispatch priorities. Record the plan in canonical Jarvis task/spec or project documentation so Manager can read and follow it. Actively resolve blockers and update the plan as work progresses. Tell Manager which Ready agents/tasks are eligible to launch and which must remain held. Deprioritize unrelated Roslyn LSP Worker6; do not assign or launch unrelated work while critical path needs capacity. Lead plans/prioritizes/unblocks; Manager alone launches; Integrator merges. Keep proportional, not bureaucracy-heavy.
